title: African Violet 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[African Violet 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: African Violet
- 관리 난이도: intermediate
- 배치: Bright indirect light on an East or North facing windowsill.
- 물주기: Bottom-water only when the top inch of soil is dry. Never get water on the fuzzy leaves.
- 토양: A very light, airy, peat-free mix (or a dedicated African Violet mix).
- 전정: Pinch off dead blooms (deadheading) and remove dying lower leaves.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright, indirect light to bloom continuously. Direct sun will burn the leaves, but too little light will stop flower production completely.

title: Aglaonema Red Siam 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Aglaonema Red Siam 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Aglaonema Red Siam
- 관리 난이도: beginner
- 배치: Highly adaptable. Survives in low light, but needs bright, indirect light to keep its neon red borders.
- 물주기: Water only when the top 2-3 inches of soil are dry. Very forgiving of missed waterings.
- 토양: A standard, well-draining indoor potting mix.
- 전정: Snip off older, yellowing leaves at the base as they naturally die.
- 광량 조건: While older green Aglaonemas can survive in pitch darkness, red varieties like the Siam Aurora require bright, indirect light to maintain their intense red borders.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 40% - 60%

title: Alocasia Amazonica 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Alocasia Amazonica 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Alocasia Amazonica
- 관리 난이도: hard
- 배치: Bright, indirect light in a very warm, humid room. Keep far away from cold windows and drafts.
- 물주기: Keep the soil slightly moist but never waterlogged. Extremely susceptible to root rot.
- 토양: A chunky, highly aerated aroid mix. Heavy peat soils will kill it.
- 전정: Cut fully yellow or dead leaves near the base of the stem. Do not cut green leaves.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright, indirect light to maintain its striking leaf coloration. Direct sun will severely scorch the leaves, while low light will cause it to drop leaves and go dormant.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 60% - 80%

title: Alocasia Black Velvet 생육 가이드 청크

title: Alocasia Macrorrhiza 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Alocasia Macrorrhiza 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]

title: Aloe Aristata 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Aloe Aristata 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]

title: Begonia Maculata 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Begonia Maculata 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]

title: Bird Of Paradise 생육 가이드 청크
text:

title: Birds Nest Fern 생육 가이드 청크
text:

- 전정: Trim brown, dead fronds at the base with clean scissors.

title: Boston Fern 생육 가이드 청크
text:

- 대상 식물: Boston Fern
- 관리 난이도: intermediate
- 배치: Bright indirect light, high humidity areas. Excellent for bathrooms or kitchens.

title: Burros Tail 생육 가이드 청크
text:

text:

title: Croton 생육 가이드 청크
text:

text:

- 전정: Wear thick gloves to prune back leggy stems; avoid contact with the toxic white sap.

- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 50%

title: Satin Pothos 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Satin Pothos 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Satin Pothos
- 관리 난이도: beginner
- 배치: Hanging basket or shelf in medium to bright indirect light.
- 물주기: Water only when the top 2 inches of soil are dry AND the leaves begin to curl slightly.
- 토양: A standard, well-draining indoor potting mix with added perlite.
- 전정: Trim long, leggy vines just below a node to encourage bushy growth at the top.
- 광량 조건: Requires medium to bright indirect light to maintain its striking silver variegation. Can survive in low light, but leaves will become smaller and solid green.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 40% - 60%

title: Schlumbergera 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Schlumbergera 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Schlumbergera
- 관리 난이도: moderate
- 배치: Bright, indirect light. Requires a strict period of total darkness in autumn to trigger blooming.
- 물주기: Water when the top inch of soil is dry. Needs significantly more water than a desert cactus.
- 토양: A fast-draining, chunky epiphytic mix.
- 전정: Twist off leaf segments after blooming to encourage bushier growth.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright, indirect light year-round. However, to bloom, it must experience 14 continuous hours of complete, uninterrupted darkness every night for six weeks in the autumn.
- 적정 온도: 60°F - 70°F (15°C - 21°C)
- 적정 습도: 50% - 60%

title: Scindapsus Treubii 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Scindapsus Treubii 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Scindapsus Treubii
- 관리 난이도: intermediate
- 배치: Bright, indirect light. Needs excellent drainage and hates sitting in wet soil.
- 물주기: Water only when the leaves curl inward and the soil is bone dry. Highly prone to rot.
- 토양: An extremely chunky, fast-draining aroid mix.
- 전정: Trim trailing vines to encourage a bushier crown, or train it up a moss pole.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright, indirect light to maintain its metallic silver color. If kept in a dark corner, the plant will stop growing entirely and revert to a dull green.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 50% - 70%

title: Senecio Radicans 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Senecio Radicans 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Senecio Radicans
- 관리 난이도: moderate
- 배치: Requires intense, bright light. The top of the pot must see the sun.
- 물주기: Water only when the soil is 100% dry and the bananas feel slightly squishy.
- 토양: Extremely fast-draining cactus mix heavily amended with pumice or perlite.
- 전정: Trim long vines to encourage branching and place cuttings back into the pot.
- 광량 조건: Requires massive amounts of bright light, including direct sun. If the top of the pot (the crown) does not receive light, the entire plant will rot and die.
- 적정 온도: 70°F - 85°F (21°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 40%

title: Spider Plant 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Spider Plant 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Spider Plant
- 관리 난이도: easy
- 배치: Indoor Bright Indirect Light to Medium Light
- 물주기: Water thoroughly when the top 50% of the soil is dry. They have thick tuberous roots that store water, making them drought-tolerant.
- 토양: Any standard, well-draining indoor potting mix.
- 전정: Trim off any brown crispy tips with sharp scissors to maintain aesthetics.
- 광량 조건: Thrives in bright, indirect sunlight. It can survive in lower light, but growth will slow drastically and variegation (the white stripes) may fade to solid green.
- 적정 온도: 60-80°F (15-27°C)
- 적정 습도: 40-60%

title: String Of Dolphins 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[String Of Dolphins 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: String Of Dolphins
- 관리 난이도: moderate
- 배치: Requires hanging directly in a bright, south or west-facing window.
- 물주기: Water only when the soil is completely dry and the dolphins begin to look slightly wrinkled or deflated.
- 토양: A very gritty, fast-draining cactus/succulent mix (e.g., 50% pumice/perlite).
- 전정: Trim long, leggy strands to encourage branching at the crown.
- 광량 조건: Requires hours of direct sunlight every day. Without intense light, the new leaves will unroll and flatten out, losing their signature dolphin shape entirely.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 80°F (18°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 50%

title: String Of Hearts 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[String Of Hearts 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: String Of Hearts
- 관리 난이도: intermediate
- 배치: Hanging basket in a very bright window with some direct sun.
- 물주기: Allow the soil to dry out completely. Water only when the leaves feel soft.
- 토양: A fast-draining cactus and succulent mix.
- 전정: Trim long vines to encourage branching and a fuller top.
- 광량 조건: Requires extremely bright light to maintain the distinct heart shape and silver marbling of its leaves. Can take several hours of direct sun.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 80°F (18°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 50%

title: String Of Pearls 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[String Of Pearls 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: String Of Pearls
- 관리 난이도: intermediate
- 배치: Hanging basket directly in front of a bright window where light hits the top of the pot.
- 물주기: Water only when the pearls begin to lose their spherical shape and feel slightly soft.
- 토양: Extremely gritty, fast-draining cactus mix. Shallow pots are required.
- 전정: Trim trailing stems if they touch the floor; lay cuttings on soil to propagate.
- 광량 조건: Requires several hours of direct morning or late afternoon sun to maintain dense, compact growth and prevent the crown from rotting.
- 적정 온도: 70°F - 80°F (21°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 40% (Standard to low home humidity)

title: String Of Turtles 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[String Of Turtles 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: String Of Turtles
- 관리 난이도: moderate
- 배치: Bright, indirect light is essential, especially from the top to prevent the crown from balding.
- 물주기: Water when the top 75% of the soil is dry. The leaves store water, but the fine roots cannot handle bone-dry drought.
- 토양: A very airy, well-draining mix. Shallow pots are mandatory due to their extremely fine, shallow root systems.
- 전정: Trim leggy stems to encourage branching and a fuller top.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright, indirect light. Crucially, the light must hit the TOP of the pot. If only the trailing vines get light, the crown will go bald and die off.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 80°F (18°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 40% - 60%

title: Stromanthe Triostar 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Stromanthe Triostar 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Stromanthe Triostar
- 관리 난이도: advanced
- 배치: Bright indirect light in a highly humid room, avoiding all direct sun.
- 물주기: Keep soil evenly moist. Water when the top 1 inch is dry using filtered/distilled water.
- 토양: A rich, well-draining peat-based mix.
- 전정: Snip off brown crispy edges or cut dead leaves at the base.
- 광량 조건: Requires bright indirect light to maintain its vibrant pink, white, and green variegation. Direct sun will burn the leaves and fade the colors.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 80°F (18°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 60% - 80%

title: Syngonium Arrowhead Plant Care 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Syngonium Arrowhead Plant Care 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Syngonium Arrowhead Plant Care
- 관리 난이도: beginner
- 배치: Bright indirect light, east or north-facing window; avoid cold winter drafts and direct hot sun.
- 물주기: Allow top 2-3 cm of soil to dry between waterings; reduce significantly in winter.
- 토양: Well-draining aroid mix (coco coir, perlite, orchid bark).
- 전정: Trim leggy vines above a node to keep shape; remove yellow or damaged leaves.
- 광량 조건: Bright, filtered light is essential for compact growth and strong variegation. East or north-facing windows are ideal. Too little light causes rapid stretching and loss of leaf patterns.
- 적정 온도: 18°C to 27°C (65°F to 80°F)
- 적정 습도: 60% to 80%

title: Syngonium Neon Robusta 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Syngonium Neon Robusta 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Syngonium Neon Robusta
- 관리 난이도: easy
- 배치: Bright, indirect light. Must have significant light to maintain its neon pink color.
- 물주기: Water only when the top 2 inches of soil are dry. Very forgiving of neglect.
- 토양: A fast-draining, chunky aroid mix.
- 전정: Snip off trailing vines regularly to keep the plant bushy and compact.
- 광량 조건: Requires significant bright, indirect light. The new leaves only emerge neon pink if the plant is receiving enough solar energy. In low light, it will turn entirely green.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 40% - 60%

title: Tradescantia Nanouk 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Tradescantia Nanouk 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Tradescantia Nanouk
- 관리 난이도: easy
- 배치: Bright, indirect light. It must have significant light to maintain its intense pink and purple colors.
- 물주기: Water only when the top 2 inches of soil are dry. Absolutely hates getting water on its leaves.
- 토양: A fast-draining indoor potting mix heavily amended with perlite.
- 전정: Requires aggressive, ruthless pruning to stop it from becoming a single long, bald vine.
- 광량 조건: Requires massive amounts of bright, indirect light to keep its vivid pink, purple, and green striping. In low light, it stretches rapidly and turns completely green.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 80°F (18°C - 27°C)
- 적정 습도: 40% - 60%

title: Tradescantia Zebrina 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Tradescantia Zebrina 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Tradescantia Zebrina
- 관리 난이도: beginner
- 배치: Bright indirect light, east or west-facing window; keep away from cold drafts and hot radiators.
- 물주기: Allow top 2-3 cm of soil to dry between waterings; water thoroughly, then discard excess water.
- 토양: Well-draining all-purpose mix with added perlite; avoid dense, moisture-retaining soils.
- 전정: Pinch back leggy stems to a leaf node to encourage bushy growth; remove dead leaves regularly.
- 광량 조건: Needs bright indirect light to maintain its distinctive purple and silver striped leaves. Too little light causes the stems to stretch and the color to revert to plain green.
- 적정 온도: 18°C to 24°C (65°F to 75°F)
- 적정 습도: 40% to 60%

title: Zamioculcas Zenzi 생육 가이드 청크
text:
[Zamioculcas Zenzi 생육 및 케어 환경 가이드]
- 대상 식물: Zamioculcas Zenzi
- 관리 난이도: beginner
- 배치: Highly adaptable. Perfect for low-light office desks or bright living rooms.
- 물주기: Water only when the soil is completely, 100% bone dry (every 3-6 weeks).
- 토양: Extremely fast-draining cactus and succulent mix.
- 전정: None required. Cut yellow, rotting stems cleanly at the soil line.
- 광량 조건: Famous for surviving in dark, windowless rooms, but it will not actually grow without light. To see new stems emerge, provide bright, indirect light.
- 적정 온도: 65°F - 85°F (18°C - 29°C)
- 적정 습도: 30% - 50%
